title: Grandma Left Me a Box: Open Only When Broke 📦
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #grandma #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: Before my grandma passed, she gave me a sealed wooden box. On it, she wrote: Open only when you are completely broke.
scenes.image: a mischievous grandmother about 80 with white hair in a bun and round glasses handing a small sealed wooden box to a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt, winking

scenes.text: At twenty-five, I lost my job. I was broke, so I opened it.
scenes.image: a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt sitting in a messy apartment opening the wooden box

scenes.text: Inside was another, smaller box. It said: Not broke enough.
scenes.image: a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt staring at a smaller box with a tiny label, confused and annoyed

scenes.text: Two years later, I had zero dollars and nothing left in my fridge. I opened the second box.
scenes.image: a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt sitting on the floor of an empty apartment opening a small box, an empty fridge open behind him

scenes.text: Inside was a folded note in grandma's handwriting. I was sure it was a bank account. A secret treasure.
scenes.image: a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt slowly unfolding an old note with hopeful sparkling eyes

scenes.text: It said: Go visit your Aunt Linda. She has owed me five thousand dollars since nineteen ninety-eight.
scenes.image: close-up of a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt reading the note, face going from hope to shock

scenes.text: So I went. Aunt Linda opened the door, saw the note, and went pale.
scenes.image: an aunt with big hair opening a door and turning pale, a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt holding up the note

scenes.text: Grandma was gone. But she still collected her debts. Through me.
scenes.image: a young man about 25 with a beard, wearing a flannel shirt counting money and looking up at the sky, a ghostly smiling a mischievous grandmother about 80 with white hair in a bun and round glasses giving a thumbs up in the clouds
